NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 22, 10:22 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 31.2 DraftKings points for $9,800, against Green Bay. Christian McCaffrey (23.7, $7,600) and Bijan Robinson (23.2, $8,500) are next.

Jahmyr Gibbs is also the top value at the position: 3.18 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 22, 10:22 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 7

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET vs GB ($9,800)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 31.2 DraftKings points at $9,800, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 7.5 points clear of Christian McCaffrey. The model gives him 22.5 carries and 5.6 targets. The salary works out to 3.18 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 31.2 points with a simulated floor of 19.1 and a ceiling of 46.7, and he holds 31% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 27.75 in a game totaled at 52.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF at ATL ($7,600)

Christian McCaffrey projects 2nd at the position with 23.7 DraftKings points at $7,600, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 14.2 carries and 6.7 targets. The salary works out to 3.12 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 23.6 points with a simulated floor of 11.6 and a ceiling of 39.9, and he holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 27.5 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs SF ($8,500)

Bijan Robinson projects 3rd at the position with 23.2 DraftKings points at $8,500, 4th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 17.0 carries and 4.8 targets. The salary works out to 2.73 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 23.1 points with a simulated floor of 11.2 and a ceiling of 39.7, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 4.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 23 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Value: Aaron Jones Sr., MIN vs IND ($6,200)

Aaron Jones Sr. projects for 18.8 DraftKings points at $6,200, which works out to 3.03 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 20 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 20.4 carries and 3.6 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Jones averaged 18.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.9 and a ceiling of 32.0, and he holds 4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Minnesota is a 6-point favorite at home against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 23.75 in a game totaled at 41.5.
